blocks.text: OrbitAvanya Tech LLP proposes a strategic partnership with EverPulse Foundation to co‑create a **digital acceleration platform** that streamlines the full lifecycle of pediatric cardiac technology funding — from grant application and donor matching to portfolio monitoring and impact reporting. EverPulse’s mission to deploy **non‑dilutive grants, directed donations, and program‑related investments** into early‑stage cardiac innovations demands a secure, scalable, and data‑rich technology backbone. OrbitAvanya brings **proprietary products** such as the **OrbitAvanya AI Analytics Dashboard**, **Cloud Migrator**, **e‑Gov Portal**, and a configurable **Grant Management Module** built on our modern **React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, AWS** stack. Together we can deliver a **joint SaaS offering** that reduces administrative overhead by **up to 40 %**, accelerates deal flow through **AI‑driven matching**, and provides real‑time **impact analytics** to donors and stakeholders. This partnership unlocks new revenue streams for OrbitAvanya via a **revenue‑share model** while empowering EverPulse to scale its funding operations globally without expanding headcount.
Key Highlights

items: **End‑to‑end Grant Lifecycle Automation** – from submission to compliance reporting
**AI‑Powered Donor‑Project Matching** – increases capital deployment efficiency
**Real‑Time Impact Dashboard** – gives donors transparent outcome metrics
**Secure Cloud‑Native Architecture** – HIPAA‑ready, SOC 2 compliant via OrbitAvanya Cloud Migrator
**Co‑Branded Accelerator Portal** – white‑label startup engagement hub for pitch competitions
**Revenue‑Share / Co‑Investment Model** – aligns incentives and lowers upfront cost

blocks.text: The pediatric cardiac technology sector is experiencing a surge in early‑stage innovation, yet funding intermediaries like EverPulse Foundation face **manual, fragmented processes** that limit throughput and transparency. Simultaneously, technology service providers are seeking **mission‑driven platforms** to showcase their AI and cloud capabilities. By uniting EverPulse’s deep domain network and capital allocation expertise with OrbitAvanya’s **full‑stack product engineering** and **proprietary analytics IP**, we can capture a **first‑mover advantage** in the niche of **impact‑focused medtech funding platforms**. The joint solution addresses a **$2.3 B** addressable market for grant‑management SaaS in health‑focused philanthropy and positions both parties as leaders in **technology‑enabled social impact**.
Finding 1 · Operational Bottlenecks in Grant Processing

EverPulse currently manages applications, reviews, and compliance tracking through a mix of spreadsheets, email, and legacy CRM tools. This leads to **long cycle times (average 8‑12 weeks)**, data silos, and limited auditability.

items: Manual eligibility screening consumes **30 % of program staff time**
No centralized document repository – version control issues
Compliance reporting for donors requires **ad‑hoc data extraction**

blocks.text: Finding 2 · Donor Engagement & Impact Visibility Gaps

Donors demand **real‑time visibility** into how capital translates into clinical milestones. EverPulse lacks a unified dashboard to surface portfolio‑level KPIs such as **number of devices in clinical trials, patient enrollment, regulatory milestones**.

items: Quarterly PDF reports are static and delayed
No self‑service portal for donors to explore outcomes
Limited ability to showcase **social return on investment (SROI)**

blocks.text: Finding 3 · Startup Acceleration Program Scalability
Pitch competitions and accelerator cohorts are managed via generic event tools, preventing **structured mentorship tracking, milestone gating, and follow‑on funding pipelines**.

items: Cohort management spread across multiple platforms
Mentor‑startup matching is manual
No integrated pipeline to convert graduates into **program‑related investments**

blocks.text: The collaboration will focus on three synergistic pillars: (1) **Grant & Investment Management Platform** – a configurable, workflow‑driven system covering application intake, review committees, compliance, disbursement, and reporting; (2) **AI‑Enhanced Donor‑Project Marketplace** – intelligent matching, portfolio analytics, and a donor‑facing impact dashboard powered by the **OrbitAvanya AI Analytics Dashboard**; (3) **Accelerator & Cohort Hub** – a white‑label portal for pitch competitions, mentor matching, milestone tracking, and seamless transition to follow‑on funding. All components will be delivered as a **multi‑tenant SaaS** hosted on AWS via OrbitAvanya’s **Cloud Migrator**, ensuring **HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2** compliance and rapid deployment.

blocks.text: We propose building **EverPulse Connect**, a co‑branded, cloud‑native platform that unifies grant administration, donor engagement, and startup acceleration into a single digital experience. The **core grant engine** leverages OrbitAvanya’s BPMN‑based workflow designer, allowing EverPulse program officers to model complex review cycles — eligibility checks, scientific review panels, board approvals — without code. Integrated **document management** (versioned, encrypted) eliminates email‑based file sharing. The **AI Matching Engine** ingests project metadata (technology readiness level, clinical indication, funding need) and donor preferences (impact focus, geography, ticket size) to generate **ranked match scores**, surfacing the highest‑fit opportunities for each capital pool. Results feed directly into the **Donor Impact Dashboard**, where stakeholders view live KPIs: **capital deployed, milestones achieved, patient‑reach projections, regulatory progress**. The **Accelerator Hub** provides a branded portal for pitch competitions: startups submit decks, mentors sign up, and program managers track cohort progress through customizable milestone gates. Successful graduates are automatically routed into the **Program‑Related Investment Pipeline**, where term sheets, due‑diligence checklists, and compliance workflows are pre‑configured. All modules share a **common data lake** on AWS (S3 + Redshift) enabling cross‑functional analytics and audit trails. Deployment follows OrbitAvanya’s **Cloud Migrator** playbook: automated VPC, IAM, GuardDuty, and Config rules ensure **HIPAA‑ready** posture from day one. The platform will be offered as a **multi‑tenant SaaS** to EverPulse, with the option to white‑label for other philanthropic partners, creating a **recurring revenue stream** shared under a **70/30 revenue‑share** (OrbitAvanya/EverPulse) after a **$150k co‑investment** for initial build.

blocks.text: The engagement follows a **phased, outcome‑driven roadmap** spanning six months, with clear gating criteria at each phase to ensure alignment, risk mitigation, and early value delivery. Phase 1 establishes joint governance and delivers the Grant Management MVP; Phase 2 adds AI matching and donor dashboard; Phase 3 completes the Accelerator Hub and launches the integrated platform to pilot users.
Engagement Timeline

rows: Joint Steering Charter, Detailed Functional Specs, Core Workflow Engine (application intake, review, approval), Document Vault, Basic Reporting, Deployed to Staging on AWS Landing Zone
AI Matching Engine, Donor Impact Dashboard & Data Lake
Trained Matching Models (v1), Donor Portal with Real‑Time KPIs, Automated ETL to Redshift, Compliance Audit Report, User Acceptance Testing with EverPulse Program Team
Accelerator Cohort Hub, Integrated Platform Launch & Go‑to‑Market

White‑Label Accelerator Portal (submission, mentor matching, milestone tracking), Program‑Related Investment Pipeline Integration, Production Hardening (WAF, DR, Backup), Co‑Branded Marketing Kit, Revenue‑Share Agreement Execution, Managed Services Handover

blocks.text: Total Estimated Duration: 6 Months (Phases 1‑3)

The partnership adopts a **co‑investment and revenue‑share model** that aligns capital risk with mutual upside. OrbitAvanya contributes **engineering capacity, IP, cloud infrastructure, and product licenses** valued at **$250k**; EverPulse contributes **domain expertise, program data, and go‑to‑market access** valued at **$150k** (in‑kind). A **$150k cash co‑investment** from EverPulse funds the dedicated sprint team for the first six months. Post‑launch, the platform generates SaaS subscription revenue (target **$500k ARR by Month 12**) split **70 % OrbitAvanya / 30 % EverPulse**. Additionally, EverPulse receives **preferred pricing** on any future OrbitAvanya product licenses and a **joint IP ownership** clause for enhancements funded jointly.
Service Level Agreement & Terms

items: Quarterly Joint Steering Committee reviews with KPI scorecards
99.9 % platform uptime SLA (excluding planned maintenance windows)
24/7 Tier‑1 support response within 1 hour for critical incidents
Data residency: all PHI/PII stored in AWS US‑East‑1 with encryption at rest and in transit
Annual SOC 2 Type II audit shared with both parties
Change Management: any scope change > 20 % effort requires mutual written approval
IP Ownership: joint ownership of co‑developed modules; background IP remains with originating party
Termination: 90‑day notice with transition assistance and data export in open formats
